slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: questions
slots.about: the deck, copied into state: id (1 up, in order), ask, options (2 to 5 records: id 1 up, in order, name), answer (the id of the right option); a pick is kept as {id, pick} and scored against the deck

slots.name: step_line
slots.about: the small counter over the bar; may read step and total

slots.name: hint
slots.about: the line under the question card: pick one

slots.name: done_line
slots.about: the big line when every question is answered; may read score and total

slots.name: wrong_lead
slots.about: in the review, the words before the right answer on a miss

slots.name: pick
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: picks one option for this question, replacing an earlier pick

slots.name: next
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: on to the next question once one is picked; the label is the button's words

slots.name: finish_label
slots.about: the words the next button takes on the last question

slots.name: back
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: back one question, its pick still there; the label is the button's words

slots.name: again
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: clears every pick and starts over; the label is the button's words

empty.shows: empty_note only; no bar, no buttons

attention.shows: the next button dimmed; a tap on it does nothing until an option is picked

fallback.shows: the score, a review row per question (miss rows name the right answer) and the again button

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink, smooth and swap
accessibility.not_colour_alone: the picked option swaps its ring for a dot; review rows carry a check or a cross and miss rows name the right answer
